title: Did You Know… He Won The First World Cup With One Arm?
subject: Héctor Castro — El Divino Manco

lines.text: Did you know the man who scored the final goal of the very first World Cup final… had only one arm?
Montevideo, nineteen-thirty. Héctor Castro was just thirteen when an electric saw took his right forearm forever.
They called him El Manco — the one-armed — a boy the game was supposed to leave behind.
Instead, he came back so beautiful to watch they gave him a second name: El Divino. The Divine One-Armed Man.
When the world gathered for the first World Cup in history, it was Castro who scored Uruguay's very first goal.
And in the final, against Argentina, ninety thousand roaring — with the clock almost dead — the one-armed man rose, and scored the last goal of the match.
Uruguay four, Argentina two. The first champions of the world… crowned by the man they said would never play at all.
